desc: Read and understand the problem statement and sample inputs.
Initial reduction to interval compatibility using p-formulation.
Verify with sample that simple non-overlapping condition is insufficient (sample has crossing intervals but compatible).
Correctly analyze two-person compatibility: given intervals [a,b] and [c,d] with a<b, c<d, find exact algebraic conditions on p_k.
Generalize to multiple people: characterize when a set of intervals is compatible (likely related to non-crossing matching or order).
Design an O(M log N + Q log M) algorithm to check compatibility for a set of people.
Implement the solution to answer Q queries.
